name: ScaledDotProductAttentionBackward

grad_output.description: shape (B, H, S_q, D); supports float16, bfloat16, float32

query.description: shape (B, H, S_q, D); same dtype as grad_output

key.description: shape (B, H, S_k, D); same dtype as grad_output

value.description: shape (B, H, S_k, D); same dtype as grad_output

attn_output.description: shape (B, H, S_q, D); forward pass output

logsumexp.description: shape (B, H, S_q); float32; logsumexp from forward pass

is_causal.description: bool; whether causal masking was applied

grad_query.description: gradient w.r.t. query; same shape and dtype as query

grad_key.description: gradient w.r.t. key; same shape and dtype as key

grad_value.description: gradient w.r.t. value; same shape and dtype as value

reference:
import torch
import math

def run(grad_output, query, key, value, attn_output, logsumexp, is_causal=False):
    query = query.float()
    key = key.float()
    value = value.float()
    grad_output = grad_output.float()

    B, H, S_q, D = query.shape
    S_k = key.shape[2]

    scale = 1.0 / math.sqrt(D)

    # Recompute logsumexp and true forward output from query/key/value
    # so that the golden reference uses self-consistent intermediates.
    attn_weight = torch.matmul(query, key.transpose(-2, -1)) * scale
    if is_causal:
        causal_mask = torch.triu(torch.ones(S_q, S_k, device=query.device, dtype=torch.bool), diagonal=S_k - S_q + 1)
        attn_weight = attn_weight.masked_fill(causal_mask, float('-inf'))
    logsumexp = torch.logsumexp(attn_weight, dim=-1)
    attn_probs = torch.exp(attn_weight - logsumexp.unsqueeze(-1))
    attn_output = torch.matmul(attn_probs, value)

    grad_value = torch.matmul(attn_probs.transpose(-2, -1), grad_output)
    grad_attn_probs = torch.matmul(grad_output, value.transpose(-2, -1))
    D_term = (grad_output * attn_output).sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
    grad_attn_weight = attn_probs * (grad_attn_probs - D_term)

    grad_query = torch.matmul(grad_attn_weight, key) * scale
    grad_key = torch.matmul(grad_attn_weight.transpose(-2, -1), query) * scale

    return grad_query.to(grad_output.dtype), grad_key.to(grad_output.dtype), grad_value.to(grad_output.dtype)
description: Backward pass for scaled dot-product attention. Computes gradients w.r.t. query, key, and value tensors. The forward pass computes: attn_weight = Q @ K^T / sqrt(D), applies optional causal mask, softmax, then output = attn_probs @ V. The backward pass uses the logsumexp from forward for numerical stability. Supports GQA (grouped query attention) via repeat_interleave on key/value heads. Common in transformer training with sequence lengths 128-4096, head dimensions 64-128, batch sizes 1-32, and head counts 8-128. Triton implementation: use @triton.jit kernels with block-level tiled matmul for grad_attn_probs = dO @ V^T and grad_V = P^T @ dO; reconstruct P from logsumexp to avoid storing the full attention matrix; compute softmax backward as dS = P * (dP - rowsum(dP * P)); apply causal mask by zeroing upper-triangular tiles; use tl.dot for all matmul ops with BLOCK_M/BLOCK_N tiling along sequence dimensions; grid = (cdiv(S_q, BLOCK_M), B * H); accumulate grad_Q and grad_K via tl.dot(dS, K) and tl.dot(dS^T, Q) scaled by 1/sqrt(D).
